thread:
Sam K: quick sanity check — after the RBAC refactor that shipped to private deployments, some control-plane KMS calls are getting 403s
Jordan M: saw a couple of those in Sentry. audit shows kms:Decrypt denied for the proxy service account
Priya S: can you paste the relevant audit line?
Jordan M: sure — from the customer's private control plane logs:
```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-19T21:40:02Z","requester":"private-controlplane-proxy@redwood-cust","action":"kms:Decrypt","resource":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/foo/cryptoKeys/bar","result":"DENIED","reason":"iam:PermissionDenied"}
```
Daren L: guess: the RBAC refactor consolidated a bunch of internal roles. the binding for `private-controlplane-proxy` -> `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` might have been dropped on some private installs during the migration
Sam K: that fits — affected customers are Dedicated/Private installs only, not hosted
Priya S: is this an RBAC policy bug or an installer drift? any diffs between expected and applied policies?
infra-bot: policy-diff job ran for customer acme-prod: 3 drifted bindings detected (private-controlplane-proxy missing kms decrypt)
Jordan M: repro steps I ran locally:
```
# simulate control plane call
curl -s -X POST https://private-controlplane.local/keys/decrypt -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}' | jq
# response = 403 + kms:Decrypt error in response body
```
Priya S: quick mitigation: rebind the KMS role to the service account for the affected installs. Daren, can you push a targeted fix?
Daren L: yes — I'll add a migration that re-adds the binding and a one-off job to reapply policies. planning to run on a single customer (staging) first.
Sam K: also want an audit alert for future regressions. create an alert on "kms:Decrypt DENIED" from any internal proxy SA for private deployments
Priya S: and add an e2e test that exercises KMS decrypt via private control plane in CI before merging RBAC refactors
Jordan M: I'll open a PR for the test and link the failing audit lines
Daren L: action plan:
- revert not necessary (scoped migration fix)
- run migration on staging (today)
- run on remaining customers (tomorrow)
- add alert and e2e test (this week)
Sam K: sound good. add an incident ticket so support + customers get notified for the affected clusters
sec-oncall-bot: INC-2026-245 created by Sam K — title: "Private control-plane KMS Decrypt denied after RBAC refactor" — priority: P2
Priya S: tagging PCI/compliance in case audit trails need retention changes @compliance-team :eyes:
Jordan M: will attach the audit snippets and policy diff to the incident
Sam K: thanks all — large customers affected are acme-prod and beta-edge. keep updates in this thread, escalate if we see any key compromise or repeated 403s :lock:
Daren L: running migration on staging now — will post results in 15m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
infra-bot: migration-job(1841240300) started for acme-prod
Sam K: received — standing by for results
